title: Cloud Networking & Migration Project
description: Designed and implemented comprehensive cloud networking infrastructure with VPC, NAT, API Gateway, and Route 53. Successfully migrated S3 data to Glacier with load balancers and Lambda triggers for automated workflows.
highlights: VPC design with public and private subnets
NAT Gateway for private instance internet access
API Gateway for RESTful service management
Route 53 for DNS management and health checks
S3 to Glacier migration with lifecycle policies
solutions: Automated migration scripts with rollback capability
Cost optimization through intelligent resource management
